task.description:
Implement backend for TM-04/TM-05 per src/design/tenant-lifecycle-controls.md:

1. Add lifecycle endpoints:
   - POST /api/v1/tenants/:slug/deactivate
   - POST /api/v1/tenants/:slug/reactivate

2. Add service/registry support for tenant status transitions ACTIVE<->INACTIVE with idempotent behavior.

3. Enforce PLATFORM_ADMIN authorization for lifecycle endpoints.

4. Add input validation rules at route boundary for slug/action/body as designed.

5. Integrate tenant activity policy enforcement for normal operations where design mandates tenant-inactive blocking.

6. Add/adjust backend integration tests for TM-04/TM-05.

Validation required before completion:
- zig build
- zig build test
- zig build migrate

Commit implementation to feature/WF02-f8-batch2-20260607 and push.
acceptance_criteria: Both lifecycle endpoints implemented and wired in src/main.zig
Status transitions are idempotent and persisted
Validation and authorization behavior matches design

result.summary: Implemented TM-04/TM-05 tenant lifecycle controls (deactivate/reactivate endpoints, idempotent status transitions, lifecycle validation, auth policy integration, and integration tests), committed and pushed to feature/WF02-f8-batch2-20260607; mandatory zig build test remains blocked by pre-existing failing definition retrieval tests.
